title: 1997 building work varied from approved plans: CCC refusal and transitional provisions (boarding house)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
code_edition: Building Act s436 (transitional) and former-Act consent (1996/97)
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Building work carried out to a boarding house in 1997 under consent BCO10215165 varied from the 1996 approved plans.
Authority's purported refusal of a CCC required an amendment to cover the variation.
Conclusion: an amendment cannot now be issued for the 1997 work; s436 transitional provisions apply to building work carried out under the former-Act consent, including the varied parts.
Appendix B compares the 1996 approved drawings with the variation (new partitions shown with solid lines).
Decision: authority incorrect in its purported refusal of the CCC on the basis that an amendment was required (28 June 2022).
